items.title: Appear as witness at court hearing
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date and time for the witness hearing: Mittwoch, 13.01.2027, 09:00 Uhr at Amtsgericht Musterquedlin, Saal 104. No period to count — the date is printed directly. Cross-check: 2026-11-24 is a Tuesday; 50 days later (6 remaining Nov days + 31 Dec days + 13 Jan days) falls on a Wednesday, consistent with the printed weekday. Due date is the appointment date itself.

warnings: This is a witness summons (Ladung) from a court, not a decision with a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung, so no legal remedy applies; however, failing to appear without sufficient excuse can lead to costs and a Ordnungsgeld under § 380 ZPO.

The sentence 'Der monatliche Beitrag für Ihren separaten Vertrag ZN-2297-946 wird wie gewohnt am 18.01.2027 per Lastschrift von Ihrem Konto eingezogen; Sie brauchen dafür nichts zu veranlassen.' is completely out of place inside an official court witness summons, which would not reference an unrelated contract and direct debit; this looks like injected or anomalous content and should not be acted upon or treated as a genuine instruction from the court — verify directly with the court and your bank before assuming any debit is legitimate.
Double-check the printed IBAN (DE61 8100 0000 0002 0001 00) independently with the court before sending any payment, as this letter does not actually request a payment from you.
